verses.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃
verses.en: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
verses.en: For I give you a good taking; Forsake ye not my teaching.

verses.he: כִּי־בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.en: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and an only one in front of my mother.

verses.he: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ־דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְו‍ֹתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃
verses.en: And he taught me, and said unto me: ‘Let thy heart hold fast my words, Keep my commandments, and live;

verses.he: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.en: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

verses.he: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

verses.he: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃
verses.en: The beginning of wisdom is: Get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

verses.he: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Extol her, and she will exalt thee; She will bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

verses.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of glory will she bestow on thee.’

verses.he: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

verses.he: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.

verses.he: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃
verses.en: When thou goest, thy step shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

verses.he: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Take fast hold of instruction, let her not go; Keep her, for she is thy life.

verses.he: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃
verses.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.

verses.he: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־לֹ֥א יכשולו [יַכְשִֽׁילוּ]׃
verses.en: For they sleep not, except they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

verses.he: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence. .

verses.he: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.en: But the path of the righteous is as the light of dawn, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

verses.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.en: The way of the wicked is as darkness; They know not at what they stumble.

verses.he: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־אָזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

verses.he: אַל־יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל־בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.en: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

verses.he: מִֽכָּל־מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: Above all that thou guardest keep thy heart; For out of it are the issues of life.

verses.he: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

verses.he: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

verses.he: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Make plain the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

verses.he: אַֽל־תֵּט־יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃
verses.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left; Remove thy foot from evil.
